studySummary.description: A concise two-sentence summary of the key findings.

ratStrain.description: Rat strain used, e.g. 'Sprague-Dawley', 'Wistar', 'Long-Evans', or 'Not Applicable'.

doses.description: Tested doses with units, e.g. '10 mg/kg/day', '100 mg/kg bw', '0 (control)'.

routeOfAdministration.description: Route of administration, e.g. 'Oral gavage', 'Diet', 'Drinking water', 'Subcutaneous injection'.

hasTranscriptomics.description: True if the study uses transcriptomics (RNA-Seq, microarrays, qPCR profiling).

noaelValues.description: NOAEL values with units and the endpoint they refer to, or empty if not reported.

loaelValues.description: LOAEL values with units and the endpoint they refer to, or empty if not reported.

ld50Values.description: LD50 values per chemical with units, or empty if not reported.

estrogenConclusion.description: One-sentence statement on estrogen-signalling markers (ERα/esr1, ERβ/esr2, aromatase Cyp19a1). 'Not assessed' if none measured.

hormoneConclusion.description: One-sentence conclusion on circulating hormone changes (E2, T, etc.). 'Not assessed' if none measured.

neuroendocrineConclusion.description: One-sentence statement on neuroendocrine markers (Kiss1, Kiss1r, GnRH). 'Not assessed' if none measured.

vtgConclusion.description: One-sentence statement on vitellogenin if measured (uncommon in mammals). 'Not assessed' if not measured.

endpoints.description: Return ONE object for EACH endocrine endpoint the study actually measured — separately per sex and per dose group when the study reports them separately. Cover these endpoint families WHERE MEASURED: (1) VTG — vitellogenin protein or vtg mRNA; (2) Estrogen-signalling genes — ERα (esr1), ERβ (esr2), aromatase Cyp19a1 (or the fish paralogs cyp19a / cyp19b if reported); (3) Hormone levels — Estradiol (E2), Testosterone (T), 11-Ketotestosterone, Progesterone, FSH, LH, T3, T4, Cortisol/Corticosterone, and the E2/T ratio; (4) Neuroendocrine genes — Kiss1, Kiss1r, GnRH (gnrh3). Do NOT create rows for endpoints that were not measured in this study.

endpoint.description: The specific marker, e.g. 'Estradiol (E2)', 'Testosterone', 'ERα (esr1) mRNA', 'Aromatase (Cyp19a1)', 'Kiss1', 'VTG protein'.

doseGroup.description: Dose/treatment group this result refers to, e.g. '100 mg/kg/day', or 'Overall' if not dose-resolved.

direction.description: Direction of change vs control: 'Increase', 'No change', 'Decrease', or 'N/A'. Do NOT include time or duration.

evidence.description: For each key finding, the exact text snippet copied verbatim from the PDF that supports it. Used for verification.
